The '''Southern Jundland Wastes''' was the region of the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] that lay south of [[the Wound]]. [[Outpost Rennar]], [[Outpost Varath]], the [[Breezefield Farms]], and the [[Shattered Basin]] were located in the area, and the [[Suns' Set Ridge]] bordered the northern edge of the Wastes.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Southern Jundland Wastes appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. The Southern Jundland Wastes did not appear formally in the planetary map of the Jundland Wastes<ref name="TOR" /> but was mentioned in the descriptions of several missions taking place in the southern part of the Jundland Wastes. These missions placed several locations in the Southern Jundland Wastes, namely the [[Abandoned Reclamation Service base]],<ref name="TOR:VD" /> the [[Breezefield Farms]],<ref name="TOR:SUtN" /> [[Outpost Rennar]],<ref name="TOR:SUtN" /><ref name="TOR:DC" /> the [[Gamorrean Bunker]],<ref name="TOR:DC" /> the [[Eastern Wound]],<ref name="TOR:TotC" /> [[Outpost Varath]],<ref name="TOR:JiD">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Journey into Dust|Tatooine}}</ref><ref name="TOR:SD">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Shields Down|Tatooine}}</ref><ref name="TOR:CV">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Confronting Veeboo|Tatooine}}</ref> the [[Southern Wastes (Jundland)|Southern Wastes]],<ref name="TOR:SD" /><ref name="TOR:TBS" /> the [[Sevarin Mesa Windfarms]],<ref name="TOR:DtGCE" /> the [[Suns' Set Ridge]],<ref name="TOR:VO" /><ref name="TOR:CF" /><ref name="TOR:Trespassing" /> and the [[Ridgeside Sentry Post]].<ref name="TOR:CF" /><ref name="TOR:Trespassing" /><ref name="TOR:VD" /> It could therefore concluded that the Southern Jundland Wastes corresponded to all the regions located south to [[the Wound]].<ref name="TOR" />
